title.rendered: Top 10 Leading IB Schools In Abu Dhabi: 2026 Review

content.rendered:
Choosing the right school in Abu Dhabi can be challenging with many international options available. This guide highlights the top IB schools in Abu Dhabi for 2026, covering key programmes, facilities, and extracurricular opportunities to help parents make informed choices.

To further support students, Ignite Training Institute in Dubai provides expert IB tutoring for Grades 8 to 12 through online and in-person sessions, helping learners achieve academic excellence at every stage.

List Of Top 10 IB Schools In Abu Dhabi

The right school plays a key role in shaping a child’s academic journey and overall development. Choosing one that offers both strong education and meaningful exposure is essential for long-term success.

With that in mind, here are the top 10 IB schools in Abu Dhabi known for their balanced and globally focused learning environments.

1. Abu Dhabi International School (AIS)

Abu Dhabi International School (AIS) offers a dynamic and inclusive learning environment with over 2,100 students from more than 55 nationalities. The school provides a choice of IB, American, and British curricula, allowing students to follow personalized academic pathways.

With strong English language support and a focus on student wellbeing, AIS ensures that every learner receives the guidance needed to succeed academically and socially.

Students benefit from a wide range of extracurricular activities, including sports, arts, and academic clubs such as robotics, debate, and Model UN. The campus is equipped with modern classrooms, technology-enabled learning, and excellent sports facilities. AIS focuses on holistic development, preparing students for higher education and global opportunities.

Key Details

  • Curriculum: IB, American, and British Curriculum
  • Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE
  • Age Group: 3 to 18 years
  • Leaving Qualifications: IGCSE, A-Levels, IB Diploma, US Diploma, AP, SAT, TOEFL, ACT
  • Language of Instruction: English
  • Average Class Size: 22 students (maximum 25)
  • Fee Range: AED 26,275 to AED 50,350 per year (2026-2027)

Related: The Ultimate Guide To International Baccalaureate (IB) Curriculum

2. GEMS World Academy Abu Dhabi

GEMS World Academy Abu Dhabi offers a globally focused education with a blend of IB and British curricula for students aged 3 to 18.

With around 860 students from 76 nationalities, the school provides a diverse and inclusive environment supported by native English-speaking teachers and strong language support programmes. Small class sizes ensure personalised attention, while technology integration through iPads, MacBooks, and interactive boards enhances the learning experience.

Students can explore a range of extracurricular activities, including sports such as football, swimming, and basketball. The campus features modern facilities like innovation studios, science labs, libraries, and dedicated play areas, along with excellent sports amenities, supporting holistic development.

Key Details

  • Curriculum: IB and British Curriculum
  • Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE
  • Age Group: 3 to 18 yearsLeaving Qualifications: IGCSE
  • Language of Instruction: English
  • Average Class Size: 20 students (maximum 22)
  • Fee Range: AED 55,420 to AED 73,890 per year (2025-2026)

3. Raha International School

Raha International School – Khalifa City Campus offers a well-rounded IB education for students aged 3 to 18 in a diverse community of over 1,700 students representing more than 80 nationalities. With native English-speaking teachers and strong language support programmes, the school ensures an inclusive learning environment.

Its focus on the IB framework encourages inquiry-based learning, critical thinking, and global awareness among students.

Students have access to a variety of extracurricular activities alongside language options such as Arabic, French, and Spanish. The campus features modern facilities, including renovated science labs, dedicated early years spaces, and excellent sports amenities like football pitches, swimming pools, and tennis courts, supporting overall student development.

Key Details

  • Curriculum: IB Curriculum
  • Location: Khalifa City, Abu Dhabi, UAE
  • Age Group: 3 to 18 years
  • Leaving Qualifications: IB Diploma
  • Language of Instruction: English
  • Average Class Size: 25 students (maximum 26)
  • Fee Range: AED 41,550 to AED 65,500 per year (2025-2026)

4. American Community School of Abu Dhabi (ACS)

The American Community School of Abu Dhabi (ACS) offers a personalised and inclusive learning environment with over 1,100 students from 56 nationalities. With a strong American and IB curriculum, the school focuses on academic excellence while nurturing curiosity, compassion, and global citizenship.

Most teachers are native English speakers, and students benefit from small class sizes that support individual growth and engagement.

ACS provides a wide range of extracurricular activities, including sports, arts, and academic clubs such as Model UN and Math Olympiad. The campus features excellent sports facilities, including turf fields, swimming pools, and gymnasiums. Through a balanced approach, ACS prepares students for lifelong learning, leadership, and success in a global environment.

Key Details

  • Curriculum: American and IB Curriculum
  • Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE
  • Age Group: 4 to 18 years
  • Leaving Qualifications: IB Diploma, AP, SAT
  • Language of Instruction: English
  • Average Class Size: 16 students (maximum 24)
  • Fee Range: AED 56,526 to AED 99,060 per year (2025-2026)

5. The British International School Abu Dhabi (BISAD)

The British International School Abu Dhabi (BISAD) offers a diverse learning environment with over 2,300 students from more than 90 nationalities. With native English-speaking teachers and strong EAL and AEN support, the school ensures inclusive education for all learners.

It follows a balanced approach to technology through its BYOD programme, combining digital tools with traditional methods. BISAD nurtures gifted students through personalised learning and academic challenges.

Students benefit from over 100 co-curricular activities and a wide sports programme, including football, rugby, and swimming. The campus features modern classrooms, libraries, creative arts spaces, a large auditorium, and excellent sports facilities, supporting holistic development.

Key Details

  • Curriculum: British and IB Curriculum
  • Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE
  • Age Group: 3 to 18 years
  • Principal: Alan Cocker
  • Leaving Qualifications: IGCSE, IB Diploma, BTEC
  • Language of Instruction: English
  • Average Class Size: 22 students (maximum 24)
  • Fee Range: AED 54,204 to AED 76,952 per year (2025-2026)

6. Emirates National School

Emirates National School (ENS) offers a structured and supportive learning environment with IB and American curricula for students aged 3 to 18. The Abu Dhabi campus primarily serves local students, creating a strong connection to UAE culture while maintaining international academic standards.

The school follows a well-defined curriculum aligned with Ministry of Education requirements and global benchmarks, ensuring consistent academic progress.

ENS focuses on continuous improvement through regular assessments and personalised teaching methods. Students benefit from language options such as Arabic and French, along with essential sports facilities including a gymnasium and playground. The school aims to develop well-rounded learners prepared for higher education and future opportunities.

Key Details

  • Curriculum: IB and American Curriculum
  • Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE
  • Age Group: 3 to 18 years
  • Leaving Qualifications: IB Diploma
  • Language of Instruction: English
  • Average Class Size: Not specified
  • Fee Range: AED 22,190 to AED 56,170 per year (2025-2026)

7. Aspen Heights British School

Aspen Heights British School offers a dynamic learning environment with British and IB curricula for students aged 3 to 18. With over 1,250 students from more than 60 nationalities, the school promotes a balanced international community.

Native English-speaking teachers and strong EAL support ensure inclusive learning, while small class sizes allow personalised attention. The school integrates advanced technology, including Google for Education tools, to enhance digital learning and student engagement.

Students can explore over 60 extracurricular activities, alongside a wide sports programme including football, swimming, and basketball. The campus features modern facilities such as science labs, performing arts spaces, a greenhouse, and excellent sports amenities, supporting holistic growth and future readiness.

Key Details

  • Curriculum: British and IB Curriculum
  • Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE
  • Age Group: 3 to 18 years
  • Leaving Qualifications: IGCSE, IB Diploma, BTEC
  • Language of Instruction: English
  • Average Class Size: 23 students (maximum 25)
  • Fee Range: AED 38,080 to AED 65,290 per year (2025-2026)

8. The Australian School Of Abu Dhabi

The Australian School of Abu Dhabi offers a balanced education through IB and Australian curricula for students aged 4 to 18. With around 1,000 students from 30 nationalities, the school provides a supportive and community-focused environment.

It offers English as an Additional Language support and additional language options such as Arabic and French, ensuring accessibility for diverse learners.

The school emphasises holistic development through academics, physical education, and values-based learning. Students participate in a variety of sports and activities, supported by facilities like a swimming pool, soccer field, and gym. With a focus on nurturing well-rounded individuals, the school prepares students for future success and global citizenship.

Key Details

  • Curriculum: IB and Australian Curriculum
  • Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE
  • Age Group: 4 to 18 years
  • Leaving Qualifications: IB Diploma
  • Language of Instruction: English
  • Average Class Size: Not specified
  • Fee Range: AED 21,383 to AED 38,034 per year (2025-2026)

9. Sama International School

Sama International School offers a premium learning experience with a blend of American and IB curricula for students aged 3 to 18. The school combines American academic standards with the IB’s inquiry-based approach, encouraging critical thinking and global awareness.

With English as the primary language of instruction and additional languages such as Arabic and Italian, students benefit from a well-rounded, multilingual environment.

Students can explore over 20 extracurricular activities, supported by modern facilities including ICT labs, science laboratories, arts and music rooms, and a cinema space. The campus also features strong sports amenities such as a swimming pool, football ground, and gymnasium, ensuring balanced academic and personal development.

Key Details

  • Curriculum: American and IB Curriculum
  • Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE
  • Age Group: 3 to 18 years
  • Language of Instruction: English
  • Fee Range: AED 30,065 to AED 53,380 per year (2025-2026)

Related: IB-MYP Programme Guide For Parents & Students

10. Al Najah Private School

Al Najah Private School offers a well-established international education with British and IB curricula for students aged 4 to 18.

With over 2,100 students from 46 nationalities, the school provides a diverse and inclusive environment supported by native English-speaking teachers and strong language support programmes. Its structured academic approach prepares students for IGCSE, A-Levels, and the IB Diploma, with a strong record of academic achievement.

Students benefit from a range of extracurricular activities, including sports, arts, and clubs such as TED-Ed and martial arts. The campus is equipped with modern classrooms, technology-enabled learning, and multiple sports facilities, supporting both academic success and personal development in a supportive, community-focused setting.

Key Details

  • Curriculum: British and IB Curriculum
  • Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE
  • Age Group: 4 to 18 years
  • Leaving Qualifications: IGCSE, A-Levels, IB Diploma
  • Language of Instruction: English
  • Average Class Size: 28 students (maximum 30)
  • Fee Range: AED 15,560 to AED 34,400 per year (2025-2026)

Related: The Ultimate Guide To International Baccalaureate (IB) Curriculum

How To Select The Best IB Schools In Abu Dhabi For Your Child?

Choosing the right school becomes easier when you rely on trusted parent feedback and clear evaluation criteria.

  • Look for schools with a parent rating of 3.0 or above, indicating overall positive feedback across key areas.
  • Prioritise schools with ratings above 3.5, as these are often highly regarded by parents.
  • Check the number of parent reviews, since more reviews make the rating more reliable.
  • Focus on recent feedback, as ratings are updated to reflect current school performance.
  • Be cautious of schools with limited reviews or lower scores, as they may lack consistent quality.
  • Use ratings as a guide alongside factors like curriculum, facilities, and extracurricular opportunities.

Related: What Is An IB World School? All You Need To Know

Ignite Training Institute – Best IB Tutors In Dubai, UAE

Ignite Training Institute is recognized as one of the best IB tutoring centers in Dubai, offering unparalleled academic support to help students achieve top scores in their IB exams.

With a team of highly qualified and IB-experienced tutors, Ignite provides personalized learning plans, focused one-on-one sessions, and a results-driven approach tailored to each student’s strengths and challenges.

Located in the heart of Dubai, Ignite has earned the trust of over 2000+ students and parents across the UAE. Their commitment to excellence, small batch sizes, and deep understanding of the IB curriculum make them a preferred choice for those aiming for 6s and 7s in their final exams.

From Internal Assessments (IAs) to Extended Essays (EEs) and Theory of Knowledge (TOK), Ignite offers comprehensive support at every stage of the IB journey.

Related: IB Program Pros & Cons: 10 Takeaways You Must Know

FAQs

1. How Many IB Schools Are There In Abu Dhabi?

There are 11 Abu Dhabi schools with IB curricula, detailing extracurriculars, teacher backgrounds, class sizes, fees, and bus services, helping you find the right fit for your child.

2. How Many IB Schools Are In UAE?

Out of the 53 IB World Schools in the UAE, 49 provide the International Baccalaureate Diploma program. To access a comprehensive list of IB World Schools located in the UAE, kindly refer to the official IB website.

3. Are IB Schools Expensive?

Yes, IB schools tend to be relatively expensive due to their rigorous academic programs and international standards.

4. What Are IB Schools In Abu Dhabi?

    IB schools in Abu Dhabi offer the International Baccalaureate curriculum, focusing on inquiry-based learning, critical thinking, and global perspectives for students aged 3 to 18.

    5. What Are The Benefits Of Studying In An IB School?

      IB schools promote holistic development, strong academic skills, and international recognition, preparing students for top universities and global career opportunities.

      Conclusion

      In conclusion, the evolving educational landscape in Abu Dhabi by 2026 boasts a diverse array of top IB schools that offer rigorous academic curricula, a global perspective, and a commitment to shaping well-rounded individuals prepared for future challenges. These institutions stand as pillars of educational excellence, nurturing students to thrive both academically and personally.

      Related: Top-Ranked IB Schools In Dubai In 2026
